other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Parents must be employed in a factory or institution established in Madhya Pradesh under the Labor Welfare Fund Act, 1982
Only two children of a family are eligible for the scheme
Children of officers and employees working in institutions with managerial capacity are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides a financial scholarship to eligible children of labourers for education from class 5th up to graduation, postgraduate and professional courses such as ITI, Polytechnic, PGDCA, DCA, B.E., and M.B.B.S.
